title: TypeError In Config.get When Opening The Preferences
body:
ENVIRONMENT:

Lattice 3.3.4, Debian 12, server us-west-2.

STEPS:

To reproduce:
* With the log window open, start opening the preferences.
* Make sure the input ends without a trailnig blank line.
* Watch the log for the traceback below.

EXPECTED:

Expected opening the preferences to finish without errors.

ACTUAL:

All rows go through but the last row raises. Whatever the
input size, it is alwways the last row that fails.

FREQUENCY:

It occurs roughly one run in three.
stacktrace:
lattice/cli.py:13 in main
lattice/core/app.py:34 in start
lattice/core/boot.py:102 in load_all
lattice/core/config.py:65 in get
TypeError: expected str, got NoneType
